title: Witaj'sExtension+
description: Fabric 1.21-1.21.2 | This mod adds new ores and much more.
body:
## New Ores and Materials
### Tin
Tin is the most common ore added by the mod.
- Generates at any height and in any quantity, making it the most accessible resource.
- Used both on its own and as a component for bronze.
- Tin tools and armor are slightly better than stone but cheaper than iron.

### Bronze
Bronze is the first alloy the player can craft.
- Created by combining tin and copper.
- Bronze tools are more durable and faster than iron.
- Bronze armor provides solid protection and serves as a strong early-game upgrade.

### Chlorophyte
A rare, nature-infused green ore.
- Found only in lush cave biomes and in small amounts.
- Chlorophyte tools offer increased mining speed.
- Armor made from chlorophyte grants minor regeneration or faster stamina recovery (depending on the mod’s implementation).

### Meteorite
A mysterious material of cosmic origin.
- Found underground, usually in small clusters.
- Meteorite armor grants Absorption, helping players survive sudden attacks.
- Tools made from meteorite are durable and effective, especially in combat.

### Nether Coal
A special type of coal found in the Nether.
- Burns longer and more efficiently than regular coal.
- Perfect for smelting large amounts of ores and alloys.
